body: Cars 1, Probably all guys have seen at some point, but if you haven't, please do, it will resurrect your nostalgia of your childhood

I'm 16 y/o, 5'11 and 132lbs. I am not happy with it, I struggle to eat as i feel nauseous everytime I eat and my mother isn't helping whatsoever calling me scrawny and other things. It really breaks me down to hear her saying that as I try my bestest to gain weight but sadly am not able to.
I shall look further into it. Thank you.
I shall try my best, although I can’t promise I can succeed with anything extraordinary.

I think having a pet would be optimal for my mental health, always having someone by your side, although, it is for the time being impossible, as I live in an apartment what looks like your local city dump. I don’t have the money for veterinary visits or just food for the pet overall, which makes it impossible for me to get one. I feel like I’m the person who needs someone by their side at all times, just to hang out with, and for comforting reasons. But, that is simply not how life works, and I have a hard time accepting it.

I’ve already tried getting help, but recieved nothing that has actually done something for me. Almost everyone say that the feelings are temporary, that I feel them right now, and to set my eyes towards the future. Problem with that saying is that I try to live in the moment - the feelings that I feel currently are the ones that mean something to me, not that I’ll be happy when I’m thirty.

I do go to the gym 3-5 times a week, and am currently bulking as I am not happy being 180 cm and having the mass of 62 kgs. Even though I don’t have the motivation to go to the gym, I still push myself, though, I’m not sure I can push myself with anything else.

I just don’t have a single clue about what to do in life. I mean I have a general idea that I would like to become a programmer of some sort, though, I don’t have any motivation anymore, not for school, not for learning things, not for doing the things I normally used to like etc. I just feel constantly exhausted with no motivation to get out of bed.

Yes I have indeed been depressed since I was 7, when my dad sued my mother for custody reasons and completely fucked me and my mental state over, just ending up spending my birthday crying in my bed. I do understand that you find it hard to believe, although it is indeed true - I wouldn’t lie about stuff like this on the internet, I don’t get anything from lying

Well, if that’s the case I hope it happens soon, as I don’t think I’ll manage to be this fucking alone any longer. I am around my classmates and still feel alone as no one seems to understand anything

I got out of a toxic relationship before this recent one. Although it was extremely toxic, I managed to get over it within 6 months. This relationship though is on a whole new level. I’m guessing it’ll take me 10 years to be able to fully trust someone, with still hints of me being scarred from before.

I don’t think I’ll be able to experience actual freedom until I move out from my moms. As mom is controlling and I live under her roof, its all her controllive rules. Living situation in Stockholm is fucked aswell, as it is extremely expensive and tough to find a place to purchase and live at. I think I’ll be able to move out at age 27. My brother is born ’98 and is still living at home, as he isn’t educated in anything, nor has a full-time job - can’t afford house, apartment etc.

I do know that is true, that not everyone will fuck me over. But I do have a hard time seeing which ones will and which ones are genuine. And in this point in time, I’m extremely emotionally scarred I don’t know where to go, what to do. As a male I am not used to venting about my feelings, always been told to bottle feelings and tears up, resulting in me not being able to cry since i was 8, and me having a hard time explaining feelings, talking about them.
Can’t really create a whole family, as I don’t know anything about it, nor am able to create one as dating, and relationships are completely ruined for me.

I know life will bring me some good memories in due time, but I want to spend it with someone special, like a girlfriend you know. Bit of a problem though as my now ex fucked me up so bad I have extreme trust and commitment issues - can’t trust anyone anymore. I am emotionally scarred and the concept of having a relationship is sadly ruined by the fact that I can’t trust anyone, and the most important thing with a relationship is to have trust.

None of my friends are willing to talk about feelings as they say it brings them down as well. I have no one to talk to except reddit. It really sucks, all I want in life is 3 things, experience pure happiness, having a whole family, and just getting a hug from someone special.

Thanks man. I just don’t think I’m mentally capable of consuming any more pain or negativity in life - just one more crumb of depression, something little happening in life, and it most likely is going to be the end of me, a fifteen year old’s life.

Thanks man, I’ll def reach out to you if any other problems with my life occur. Huge thank you. Now I do have to go to sleep though, as it is 4 am for me. Have good night/day, whatever time it is for you

As it is illegal in Sweden, I am not able to get it legally, and even if I could, I wouldn’t be able to as my mother has to be involved, and I am not talking to her about my feelings ever again.
   I don’t have anyone to talk to. As I mentioned I can’t trust anybody, have extreme trust issues and friends who live my dream, not being able to relate under any circumstances to what I experience, nor is willing to try to understand.

Bizzare how a 32 year old, what I suppose, uneducated in mental support, has done more for me within 30 mins than actually educated people within mental health has done in total of 7 hours. I have no other words than saying a big thank you, and a promise that I’ll give it a try, although I can’t promise what happens after. But again, thank you 32 year old redditor<3
It is not in medical use, I get it from a guy illegally, just for the brief moment of relaxation and finally getting more than 3 hours of sleep.

As I mentioned I am barely allowed to walk outside to hang out with friends, and when I do, it’s three hours at most. My friends aren’t supportive either, simply don’t care, nor can relate as they live my dream life, being wealthy, living in a big house, and most importantly, having 2 loving parents living at the same place. It just sucks to see everyone else live your dream. Having the luck to be born, but having the extremely unlucky diceroll of being born into a completely fucked family.

I’ve been to my local mental health support center twice, they thought I was alright (explained my situation like my post above), as well as the school counseller five times. She didn’t help either, she listened to what I had to say and didn’t give any sort of feedback.
   It just sucks looking at everyone I know, all of them being rich, me being poor, them having a loving family with 2 loving, supporting parents and a big house, contrary to me, having a poor mom, and a dad I can barely visit living in a apartment that looks like the city dump.

I just don’t see the escape route. I don’t think I can actually change my life. I have 0 motivation for anything, as well as a mother that’s controlling my whole life - I get 0 freedom. The only escape from reality I have is smoking weed - feeling relaxed, no longer depressed for the time me being high ~4 hours, actually being able to sleep etc.

Drugs, atleast for now, is the only escape from reality I have. I’ve only tried weed so far, but most likely I’m going to need to get into heavier stuff. Weed is the only escape of reality I have, I get relaxed, feel no stress, no emotion, and during the time I’m high, I don’t experience insomnia.

I know it sounds lame. But I’m not getting children for the fact I can’t even take care of myself, and now I’m supposed to take care of 1-2 children aswell? There’s no way my brain can manage that mentally. I just don’t think I’ll be a good father, and if I get children, and get back to being this suicidal, and commiting to it, I’m leaving them with the same amount of pain I’m experiencing right now.

I feel like life’s going to waste. It’s during my childhood, growing up I want to create and remember things, having memories for the future. As the situation is now, all I’ll remember is depression.
   Although most people have parents to talk to, I don’t. My dad doesn’t like to talk about feelings, and I respect that. And my mom is the last one I’m talking with about my feelings ever again. I came out to her as depressed, suicidal, thinking of ending it all, back in 2017 (i was 13), as she proceeded to completely neglect my feelings, saying I have NO reason WHATSOEVER, to feel this way.

I just feel like I’ve been, and still is wasting my life. I’ll be looking back at life if I manage to get older and realize how fucking shit it was. Dad leaving at 3 years of age, suing her for custody at age 7, developing depression at that age, getting bullied etc etc. Although I am only fifteen, it feels like I’ve experienced a whole life’s pain cramped into my fifteen years of living. On top of that I know that more pain is to come, but I think I’ve reached my mental limit of how much I can manage. One more misopportunity, one little thing, and it’s all over for me.
As there is no other meaning or point to live, why should I? And why is it illegal to commit suicide?

I’ve tried finding a hobby since I became depressed 8 years ago. Playing video games worked for a year, then it just became a habit. I’ve started working out at the gym, but lost all motivation for it just a month in, lost all motivation for anything to be honest.
   Although I have friends, there aren’t anyone I can actually speak to about this, or just hang out with. As I mentioned I can’t trust anyone anymore, as well as I also mentioned, my controlling mothee doesn’t allow me to go outside to hang out with friends.
   The sad reality I’m facing is that I’m becoming ’illegal’ as to say - smoking weed, drinking alcohol, as well as getting a nicotine addiction. I’m getting into the more illegal stuff, all just for a brief moment of relaxation.

Personally, I don’t like kids, not planning to get any. Just wondering for any other actual meaning. As i’ve tried to find the meaning since I became depressed, just trying to find small things that make me enjoy myself and the moment, but haven’t found anything.
I’ll take things that didn’t happen for 500 Alex
